# P03 · AI platform and guardrails core — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** One disciplined path for every Claude call: config, registry, versioned prompts, `run_call` with structured output, caching, retries, fallbacks, budget guard and audit row.
Rule-based validators and pre-filter, the call 7 output checker with reading level and rejection examples, gates, badges and explanations.
Red-team harness, budget command, judge endpoints, all testable offline with recorded responses.

**Read:** CLAUDE.md §7, §8; BUILD_PROMPTS P03; design §AI layer and §Guardrails.

**Starting commit:** `9bfc51c` · **Started:** 2026-10-16

## Tasks

- [ ] **T01 · Verify API facts, pricing.yaml, DECISIONS** — done when DECISIONS holds the facts and `ai/pricing.yaml` has URL and date.
- [ ] **T02 · Config, pricing loader, registry (8 calls, five layers)** — test: `tests/ai/test_registry.py`.
- [ ] **T03 · Validators: numbers, quotes, length, language, pii, arithmetic** — tests per validator, mypy strict.
- [ ] **T04 · Validators: readability, prefilter + content/safety, content/lang** — seeded profanity in three scripts and romanised.
- [ ] **T05 · DB models: ai_calls, review_items, review_decisions, teacher_flags, consents** — test: `tests/ai/test_models.py`.

- [ ] **T07 · `run_call`: recorded/record/live, retry, fallback, budget, audit** — `tests/ai/test_client.py`.
- [ ] **T08 · Call 7 checker + rejection examples** — `tests/ai/test_checker.py`.
- [ ] **T09 · Gates, badges, explanations (en/hi/ta)** — `tests/ai/test_guard.py`.
- [ ] **T10 · Red-team harness + 12 seeds** — `tests/evals/test_redteam.py`.
- [ ] **T11 · `tasks.py budget`, `readme`, judge endpoints** — `tests/ai/test_judge_api.py`, `tests/ai/test_budget_cmd.py`.
